open_items: Fund not recorded: search summaries cite Sifted for a EUR60M final close on 2025-05-22 (earlier EUR15M/EUR50M first-close figures conflict), but the Sifted page returned HTTP 403 and was not read; the lead's $68M / 2025-05-27 is unconfirmed.
Stages not stated beyond 'early-stage' on the site; not recorded. Check size shown in dollars on the site ($250k-$2m); search summaries gave EUR250k-2m, unverified.
HQ: site lists San Francisco, Paris and Berlin without naming a head office; Paris taken from the lead and the firm's French origin (not confirmed on a fetched page).

Rift round: Startups Magazine gives no stage label (one aggregator says seed, OVNI's LinkedIn reportedly pre-seed); includes EUR1.6M public funding per search summary. Lightspring amount is the EUR3.1M seed (EUR3.5M incl. EUR350k grant). Dates are article dates.
Contact is by email only (published on the site, deliberately not recorded); no application URL. Site portfolio section was empty.
